edges.subject: CLN6
edges.quote: a 12.4-kb deletion involving the CLN6 gene was the top candidate because its homozygous abnormalities cause neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: We report a family with progressive myoclonic epilepsy who underwent whole-exome sequencing but was negative for pathogenic variants.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: Similar clinical courses of a devastating neurodegenerative phenotype of two affected siblings were highly suggestive of a genetic etiology
